newsitem.title: USA: Salomon starts Mexico's Penoles with buy.
newsitem.headline: Salomon starts Mexico's Penoles with buy.

text.p: --Salomon Brothers starts coverage of Mexican mining group Penoles with a buy recommendation, estimating fully diluted earnings per share of $0.32 in 1996 and $0.36 in 1997.

--"Penoles's shares are a good value investment vehicle with tremendous growth potential. We expect the company's earnings to experience a dramatic upswing after 1998," analysts Mauricio Reveco and Harold Liberge write.
--Penoles, the world's largest silver producer and fourth largest metals company, is expected to launch major explorations in Peru and Argentina.
--"Penoles will continue consolidating its leading position in silver and is rapidly increasing its position in gold," the analysts say.
--Among the positive factors for the company are its vertical integration, the diversification of its products and low volatility due to the long-term nature of its contracts.

--Risks include the July 6 congressional elections in Mexico, changes in the exchange rate, the costs of labor and energy and the succession of Alberto Bailleres as chairman of the board. ((--Daniel Perez-Whitaker, Monterrey bureau, (528) 345-7617))
